name: ux-review
description: UX Review: walk the key tasks of a site or app through 10 UX lenses and get a visual report, a usability-test plan and a hands-off file for AI agents.

plugins.name: ux-review
plugins.description: Walk key user tasks step by step (cognitive walkthrough), check Nielsen's 10 heuristics, IA, microcopy, forms, trust, accessibility basics, mobile, decision support and error states; get a prioritized, render-checked HTML report, a 5-task usability-test plan and a hands-off brief.
